The main takeaway from our work is that
, in many cases, a sub-optimal structure can be learned in a fraction of time with respect to the optimal one, and that such sub-optimal structure is often good enough in terms of inference accuracy.
a simple and efficient SPN structure learning algorithm can be achieved by adopting fast procedures to determine RVs’ independencies, and by using a simple and fast procedure to find sub-populations.
